VERDICT: CHANGES REQUESTED

The change is well-placed overall: `getAgeBand()` sits naturally among the file's existing family of `@Transient` derived getters (`getMembershipNumber`, `getCheckDigit`, `getMembershipLevel`, `getContactPreference`, etc.), the null-guard + javadoc style matches its neighbours, and the `birth_date` column is added consistently across all four DB schemas plus the OpenAPI schema. One idiom nit:

- `Owner.java:137` uses the fully-qualified `java.time.Period.between(...)` inline. Every other type in this file — including the sibling `java.time.LocalDate` used throughout — is imported (line 24) and referenced unqualified; none of the existing derived getters inline an FQN. Add `import java.time.Period;` and call `Period.between(...)` so the new getter reads like the rest of the file.
